website.sub: Your articles in Arabic and English: write, review and get them ready for the site
website.localOnly: Articles live on this device until the website is connected; nothing is public.
website.storageBlocked: This browser is not keeping data (private mode or full storage). What you write may be lost when the page closes, so download a copy first.
website.emptyHint: Start a new article; it saves on your device as you type.
website.field.title: Title
website.slugHint: Lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes only, like night-grading
website.coverHint: https links only. Pictures stored on this device do not travel with the article.
website.previewEmpty: Write something to see the preview.
website.noIssues: All good: you can mark it ready.
website.issue.body-ar: The Arabic article text is missing
website.issue.body-en: The English article text is missing
website.issue.body-device-media: The {lang} text has a picture from this device (img:, blob: or data:); use an https link
website.issue.slug-format: The article link must be lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes
website.issue.slug-duplicate: Another article uses the same link
website.issue.cover-not-https: The cover link must start with https
website.readyNote: Ready means reviewed on your device, not published. Any edit makes it a draft again.
website.archivedNote: This article is archived. Restore it to edit.
website.save.notPersisted: Not kept by the browser. Your text is still here; download a copy or try again.
website.save.conflict: This article changed somewhere else (another tab or an import). Your text is still here.
website.gone: This article was removed (import or reset). Your text is still here so you can copy it.
website.save.unsupported: This browser cannot save safely. Copy your text or use Chrome.
website.restoreDuplicate: An active article already uses this link: {title}
website.unsavedPrompt: There is an unsaved draft of this article. Restore it?
website.downloadUnsaved: Includes unsaved changes · not saved on this device
website.readyBlocked: Not marked ready: a "When an article is ready" workflow is linked to the cloud Worker (or that link isn't clear yet), so it can't run on this device. Nothing changed.
